description_en: Enables or disables SCIM user synchronization independently. When enabled, the initial full import is executed asynchronously. You can query the result by calling GetIdentityProviderSCIM. The SAML logon configuration is retained
description_zh: 独立启用或关闭 SCIM 用户同步。开启时异步执行首次全量导入，结果通过 GetIdentityProviderSCIM 查询，保留 SAML 登录配置
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-identity-provider-scim --workspace-id ws-example --biz-body syncEnabled=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target workspace. This parameter is required. The request region must be the same as the region of the target workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: Do not set this parameter to true during CustomSSO initialization. You can only update it later by calling UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM. Determine the result based on operationStatus
fields.help_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；后续只能通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 更新，结果结合 operationStatus 判断
fields.name: sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: Submits business parameters as described in this API. The body parameters of the public API are mapped to the backend wrapper by the gateway. Do not mix them with the backend direct connection body wrapper
parameters.help_zh: 按本接口说明提交业务参数；公开 API 的 body 参数由网关映射到后端包装，不混用后端直连 body 包装
parameters.name: body

code.description_en: The business result code. If the request fails, handle the error based on the HTTP status code and the message
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

data.description_en: The shared binding after the request is accepted. The status indicates the status of shared resources and logon configurations, not the status of this SCIM task. Query GetIdentityProviderSCIM.operationStatus for the execution result
data.description_zh: 保留旧字段和 status 含义；新增 scimStatus 与查询接口 data.status 对应，operationStatus 保留最近 SCIM 任务状态

configuration.description_en: The actual upstream configuration. The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only in GetIdentityProvider. SCIM query and prepare operations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type. Valid values: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. The query returns the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The entity ID of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It cannot be empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. Existing configurations cannot be replaced. This is different from the entity ID of the SP returned by the SP query
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual SSO logon status of AgentIdentity. The actual switch value is Enabled or Disabled, which is not equivalent to the expected loginEnabled value saved in AC
ssoStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled，不等同 AC 保存的 loginEnabled 期望值
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

createdAt.description_en: The creation time recorded by the server
createdAt.description_zh: 服务端记录的创建时间

eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_en: The event subscription callback URL. CustomSSO returns an empty string. You can obtain the SCIM receiving address through the SCIM query or prepare API. The example shows a JSON empty string "". The actual value does not contain double quotes
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_zh: CustomSSO 返回空字符串；SCIM 接收地址通过 SCIM 查询或准备接口取得。示例以 JSON 空字符串 "" 展示，实际值不包含双引号
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.title_en: SAML 不使用厂商事件回调地址
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.title_zh: SAML 不使用厂商事件回调地址

identityProviderType.description_en: The identity provider type. General CRUD operations support DingTalk, Feishu, and CustomSSO. SP queries only support CustomSSO. The SCIM path fixedly uses the CustomSSO shared pool
identityProviderType.description_zh: 通用 CRUD 支持 DingTalk、Feishu、CustomSSO；SP 查询仅支持 CustomSSO。SCIM 路径固定使用 CustomSSO 共享池

loginCallbackUrl.description_en: The logon callback URL. CustomSSO returns an empty string. You should obtain the ACS URL for SAML through the SP query API. The example shows a JSON empty string "". The actual value does not contain double quotes
loginCallbackUrl.description_zh: CustomSSO 返回空字符串；SAML 的 ACS 地址应通过 SP 查询接口取得。示例以 JSON 空字符串 "" 展示，实际值不包含双引号
loginCallbackUrl.title_en: SAML 不使用厂商回调地址
loginCallbackUrl.title_zh: SAML 不使用厂商回调地址

loginEnabled.description_en: The logon switch. Do not set this parameter to true during CustomSSO initialization. You must save a valid SAML configuration before enabling it. Disabling it does not delete the configuration. When an asynchronous failure occurs, this expected value does not mean that it has taken effect on the upstream
loginEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；启用前须保存有效 SAML 配置。关闭不删除配置。异步失败时该期望值不代表上游已生效

metadata.description_en: The standard IdP metadata. Vendor parameters are used for DingTalk and Feishu. CustomSSO updates use protocol and saml, and do not accept this field. The return value does not contain vendor keys
metadata.description_zh: 厂商参数用于 DingTalk、Feishu；CustomSSO 更新使用 protocol、saml，不接受此字段。返回值不含厂商密钥

binding.description_en: The canonical SAML binding identifier. It is the SAML binding URI in the historical metadata snapshot. For CustomSSO updates, use saml.bindingType
binding.description_zh: 历史 metadata 快照中的 SAML Binding URI；CustomSSO 更新请使用 saml.bindingType
binding.title_en: 规范化 SAML 绑定标识
binding.title_zh: 规范化 SAML 绑定标识

certificates.description_en: The canonical SAML certificate content. It is the certificate string in the historical metadata snapshot. To edit the configuration, use saml.x509Certificates and do not submit the old metadata
certificates.description_zh: 历史 metadata 快照中的证书串；编辑配置使用 saml.x509Certificates，不提交旧 metadata
certificates.title_en: 规范化 SAML 证书内容
certificates.title_zh: 规范化 SAML 证书内容

entityId.description_en: The entity ID of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It cannot be empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. Existing configurations cannot be replaced. This is different from the entity ID of the SP returned by the SP query
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

operationStatus.description_en: PENDING/RUNNING 时轮询 GetIdentityProviderSCIM；保留失败、暂停和取消事实，不表示 SAML 状态
operationStatus.description_zh: PENDING/RUNNING 时轮询 GetIdentityProviderSCIM；保留失败、暂停和取消事实，不表示 SAML 状态
operationStatus.title_en: 最近一次 SCIM 操作状态
operationStatus.title_zh: 最近一次 SCIM 操作状态

protocol.description_en: The logon protocol. Currently, only SAML is supported. This field may not be returned if no valid configuration is saved. OIDC placeholder initialization is not supported
protocol.description_zh: 当前仅支持 SAML；未保存有效配置时可不返回。不支持用 OIDC 占位初始化

saml.description_en: The SAML logon configuration. The input supports either XML or complete manual entry. The query returns the standardized configuration and does not echo the original XML. This field can be omitted if it is not configured
saml.description_zh: 输入支持 XML 与完整手填二选一。查询返回标准化配置，不回显原始 XML；未配置时可省略

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type. Valid values: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. The query returns the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The entity ID of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It cannot be empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. Existing configurations cannot be replaced. This is different from the entity ID of the SP returned by the SP query
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

x509Certificates.description_en: The list of IdP signing certificates. When you manually enter the configuration, this parameter is required and must be a non-empty array. Use PEM X.509 certificate text. The current validity period is verified. A maximum of two certificates are allowed after deduplication
x509Certificates.description_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，去重后最多 2 张

items.description_en: An IdP signing certificate. It is a valid PEM X.509 signing certificate. The example shows a public test certificate for idp.example.com. For actual access, you must replace it with the certificate of the external IdP
items.description_zh: 一张有效 PEM X.509 签名证书；示例为 idp.example.com 的公开测试证书，实际接入须替换为外部 IdP 的证书

scimStatus.description_en: 独立 SCIM 状态；不改变原 status 的共享资源及登录配置含义。与查询接口的 data.status 对应
scimStatus.description_zh: 独立 SCIM 状态；不改变原 status 的共享资源及登录配置含义。与查询接口的 data.status 对应

status.description_en: The operation status of shared resources and logon configurations. It indicates the user pool lifecycle and logon configuration task status of CustomSSO, and does not represent the SCIM operation result. Query GetIdentityProviderSCIM.operationStatus for the SCIM switch result. You cannot use this field to determine whether all protocols are configured
status.description_zh: CustomSSO 的用户池生命周期及登录配置任务状态，不表示 SCIM 操作结果。SCIM 开关结果通过 GetIdentityProviderSCIM.operationStatus 查询；不能据此判断各协议均已配置
status.title_en: 共享资源及登录配置操作状态
status.title_zh: 共享资源及登录配置操作状态

syncEnabled.description_en: Do not set this parameter to true during CustomSSO initialization. You can only update it later by calling UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM. Determine the result based on operationStatus
syncEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；后续只能通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 更新，结果结合 operationStatus 判断

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time recorded by the server
updatedAt.description_zh: 服务端记录的最近更新时间

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the target workspace. This parameter is required. The request region must be the same as the region of the target workspace
workspaceId.description_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致

data.title_en: 原有绑定详情及新增 SCIM 状态
data.title_zh: 原有绑定详情及新增 SCIM 状态

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. It indicates the processing status of this request and is not equivalent to the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: Task result message. It is the request acceptance or error message. For asynchronous tasks, you must check task result by calling the corresponding query API
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The request ID. It is used to associate this call with troubleshooting. Retain it when a failure occurs
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. For asynchronous writes, you must continue to query the task result
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
